summary: Nanobiotix S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, attaching a press release announcing management participation in the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on September 15, 2026, at 12:00 pm EDT in New York. CEO Laurent Lévy and CFO Bart Van Rhijn will present in a fireside chat. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is a routine investor-conference scheduling announcement for the French biotech, mapped to a US equivalent of a routine 8-K investor-relations notice; no deal or special-situation angle exists.
